comment: Configs the Go composer accepts and refuses (ParseConfig, then validateComposable), which @sealed/core's
sealedConfigSchema must accept and refuse alike. Read by runtime/composer TestConfigParity and by
packages/core/test/configParity.test.ts; the format is described in config_parity_test.go. Valid cases carry the
composer's configHash; after a composer version bump run go test ./runtime/composer -run TestConfigParity -update-parity.

cases.name: composerVersion other
cases.why: the composer refuses every version but its own; the platform serves several composer versions, so the schema only requires one
